title: Dekopon tech almanac
description: An implementation-grounded field guide to Dekopon v0.2.0 isolation, custom tools, permissioning, durable audit, and OpenTelemetry.

chapters.label: Atlas
chapters.title: Map the v0.2 machine
chapters.description: The working local control plane: one unprivileged runner, one privileged broker, bounded components, audit, and telemetry.

chapters.label: Isolation & linking
chapters.title: Two Wasm hosts, two authority profiles
chapters.description: How the empty direct linker and broker-owned HTTP linker give custom providers exactly—and only—the powers intended for each path.

chapters.label: One-tool design
chapters.title: One JSON-native tool, many capabilities
chapters.description: Follow a model-authored plan through the sandboxed shell, capability dispatch, Wasm, broker fallback, and bounded results.

chapters.label: Permissioned lifecycle
chapters.title: From proposal to durable outcome
chapters.description: Trace trusted identity, exact policy, single-use authorization, constrained execution, replay defense, and failure semantics.

chapters.label: Audit & OpenTelemetry
chapters.title: Three signals, one correlated run
chapters.description: Separate authorization audit from OTLP traces and logs, follow W3C context across the socket, and inspect the measured OpenObserve footprint.
